resume_text:
Marcus Vance
Senior Backend Systems Engineer | New York, NY

Executive Summary:
Backend Systems Engineer with 6+ years of hands-on experience designing and scaling distributed microservices architectures in Python. Expert in high-concurrency AsyncIO frameworks, PostgreSQL query optimization, Redis caching strategies, and event-driven streaming with Apache Kafka and RabbitMQ on AWS Kubernetes infrastructure.

Technical Skills:
- Backend Languages & Frameworks: Python (FastAPI, Django, AsyncIO), gRPC, REST APIs, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy
- Databases & Caching: PostgreSQL, Redis, PgBouncer, MongoDB, DynamoDB
- Messaging & Async: Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, Celery, Event-Driven Architecture
- Cloud & DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS (EKS, RDS, ElastiCache), Terraform, CI/CD Pipelines

Work Experience:
Senior Backend Systems Engineer | DataScale Systems (2021 - Present)
- Architected high-throughput FastAPI microservices serving 35M+ daily API requests with median response latency of sub-35ms.
- Diagnosed and resolved PostgreSQL database connection starvation by implementing PgBouncer connection pooling and optimizing high-impact queries using EXPLAIN ANALYZE.
- Designed a resilient Redis cache-aside system with TTL jitter to eliminate thundering herd problems during peak traffic surges.
- Built distributed event ingestion pipeline using Apache Kafka and Celery, processing 500k messages/minute with zero message loss.

Backend Engineer | StreamLine Technologies (2018 - 2021)
- Developed microservices with Django and FastAPI, integrating gRPC services over HTTP/2 for internal service-to-service communication.
- Maintained CI/CD deployment pipelines on AWS EKS with Kubernetes Horizontal Pod Autoscaling (HPA) and Prometheus monitoring.
